caption: Read the chain downward: the farm's 500 nodes carry only 533.33 bit/s of mean traffic, yet the 51-byte payload limit splits every 80-byte reading into 2 frames, so 144,000 frames leave the farm each day.

spec.title: The 500-node farm, worked through
spec.aria: A downward chain of seven boxes for the 500-node farm: 500 nodes sending 80 bytes every 10 minutes, 144 messages per node per day, 72,000 messages per day, 5.76 MB per day, a mean rate of 533.33 bit/s, then 2 frames per reading because 80 bytes exceeds the 51-byte payload, giving 144,000 frames per day.
